text:
amar: Quick ping 1: vendor just messaged: shortage in us-east1, offering to move our 6x h100 reservation to us-central2 for tonight only. Need to confirm whether nightly sweep (staging) can tolerate us-central2.
nina: Can staging talk to that region? Networking and peering are the main constraints.
sam: Yes, technically. We'll need a temporary region alias + a peering ACL. I can do a tiny infra PR to map region for the sweep.
tess: Demo pool in us-central2 currently shows 2 h100s free but they're tagged "demo-reserved". We might borrow if owners are ok.
amar: Vendor also said they'd require a subnet CIDR for peering and one-off billing flag. Estimated cost: 6 * $3.0/hr * 4.5 hr ~= $81.
billing-bot: Note: rough usage estimate posted to billing channel, will confirm final after PR lands.
nina: What's the fallback if peering fails or the vendor fails to hand over?
sam: Fallback = reduce concurrency and shift traffic to quantized h100 variant or l4s. I'll add a router rule that prefers us-east1 but will route to us-central2 only for staging label and will drop to smaller model if region != us-east1.
amar: Snippet vendor requested for peering (will share with infra):
```
resource "cloud_peering" "vendor_temp" {
  project     = "redwood-staging"
  region      = "us-central2"
  peer_cidr   = "10.40.0.0/22"
  purpose     = "one-off vendor shift for nightly sweep"
}
```
tess: I'm DMing demo owners now. If they release the 2 reserved h100s, we can take 4 from vendor + 2 from demo pool and avoid changing billing addendum.
billing-bot: Finance pre-approval: up to $120 one-off spend ok for infra experiments (informal). Please tag PR with TKT-8490.
amar: I'll post PR once infra change is ready. If demo team denies, we'll need to sign addendum.
sam: I'll prepare PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/515 (region alias + router fallback). CC @nina.
nina: Demo owner replied: can release tonight after 5pm PT. Good to proceed.
amar: OK landing plan: 1) land infra PR, 2) request vendor to start handoff, 3) run sweep with reduced concurrency flag first 30m, 4) escalate if failures.
infra-bot: infra/pull/515 deployed to staging, smoke checks passed.
amar: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in billing and close ticket TKT-8490 when done. :thumbsup:
